items.hook: Unveiled in 1898, the statue was criticized for its poor design, and in 1900 the statue was toppled and buried by townspeople.

items.hook: Patent number US1781541 is awarded to Albert Einstein and Leó Szilárd for their invention, the Einstein refrigerator.
items.body: A patent is a type of intellectual property that gives its owner the legal right to exclude others from making, using, or selling an invention for a limited period of time, in exchange for publishing an enabling disclosure of the invention. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Quekettia is a small genus of orchids classified in the subtribe Oncidiinae.
items.body: This genus is found in the humid lowlands of Brazil, the Guianas, Venezuela, Ecuador and Trinidad. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.body: But the court dismisses the other part of Trump's lawsuit that alleged the BBC had violated a Florida law.

items.hook: Napoleonic Wars: Battle of Dürenstein: Eight thousand French troops attempt to slow the retreat of a vastly superior Russian and Austrian force.
items.body: The Napoleonic Wars (1803–1815) were a global series of conflicts fought by shared European coalitions against the French First Republic (1803–1804) under the First Consul followed by the First French Empire (1804–1815) under the Emperor of the French, Napoleon I. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The election of pope Martin V at the Council of Constance ends the Western Schism.
items.body: Pope Martin V, born Oddone Colonna, was the head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 11 November 1417 to his death in February 1431. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Sir William Howard Russell, was an Irish reporter with The Times, and is considered to have been one of the first modern war correspondents.
items.body: He spent 22 months covering the Crimean War, including the Siege of Sevastopol and the Charge of the Light Brigade. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed

items.body: Elizabeth II was Queen of the United Kingdom and other Commonwealth realms from 6 February 1952 until her death in 2022. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Yinshan zhengyao is a Chinese cookbook and medical text written by Hu Sihui.
items.body: It was first published in 1330, although the original manuscript is no longer extant; all modern editions of Yinshan zhengyao are based on the Ming dynasty edition published in 1456. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Dutch invasion fleet of William of Orange departs from the Dutch Republic for the second time, beginning the 1688 invasion of England.
items.body: William III and II, also known as William of Orange, was the sovereign Prince of Orange from birth, Stadtholder of Holland, Zeeland, Utrecht, Guelders, and Overijssel in the Dutch Republic from 1672, and King of England, Scotland, and Ireland from 1689 until his death in 1702. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Voyager is one light day away from us. Here’s what it discovered on its epic journey
items.body: The Voyager 1 spacecraft is the most distant human-made object from Earth. What it saw on its 50-year journey to the edge of the solar system revolutionised our understanding of the planets and ourselves
